translations.literal: Boling, son of Xue Andu, seized the four commanderies of Yong; Inspector Prince Xiuruo of Baling attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Andu's son Boling seized four Yong commanderies; Inspector Prince Xiuruo of Baling attacked and executed him.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔曰：「古者衡虞置制，蝝蚳不收；

translations.literal: On dingyou in the eighth month, an edict said: "In antiquity the balance and the basket were set in place, and even ants and larvae were not gathered;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the eighth month an edict said: "In antiquity the state set balances and measuring baskets, and even ants and larvae were left ungathered;

sentences.zh: 川澤產育，登器進御。

translations.literal: rivers and marshes produced their bounty, which was brought up for the imperial table.
translations.idiomatic: rivers and marshes yielded their bounty for the imperial table alone.

sentences.zh: 所以繁阜民財，養遂生德。

translations.literal: thereby to enrich the people's wealth and nurture the virtue of sustaining life.
translations.idiomatic: thus enriching the people and nurturing the virtue of sustaining life.

sentences.zh: 頃商販逐末，競早爭新，折未實之菓，收豪家之利，籠非膳之翼，為戲童之資。

translations.literal: Recently merchants chase the secondary trades, competing to harvest early and vie for novelty, plucking fruit not yet ripe, seizing great families' profits, caging wings unfit for food, making resources for toy children.
translations.idiomatic: Lately merchants chase profit, racing to pick fruit before it ripens, squeezing great houses for gain, trapping birds unfit for the kitchen, and turning them into children's playthings.

sentences.zh: 豈所以還風尚本，捐華務實。

translations.literal: How can this restore custom and honor the root, discard ornament and pursue substance?
translations.idiomatic: How can that restore plain custom, honor the root, and cast off ornament for substance?

sentences.zh: 宜修道布仁，以革斯蠹。

translations.literal: It is fitting to cultivate the Way and spread benevolence to reform this corruption.
translations.idiomatic: The court should cultivate the Way and spread benevolence to uproot this abuse.

sentences.zh: 自今鱗介羽毛，肴核眾品，非時月可採，器味所須，可一皆禁斷，嚴為科制。

translations.literal: From now on, scales, shells, feathers, delicacies, and all such products not harvestable in their proper season and not required for vessels and flavors may all be forbidden without exception, with strict statutes enacted."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth scales, shells, feathers, delicacies, and every product not in season and not required for the imperial table are forbidden outright, under strict statutes."

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，以中領軍沈攸之行南兗州刺史，率眾北討。

translations.literal: On renyin, Colonel of the Garrison Shen Youzhi acted as Inspector of Southern Yan and led troops north on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Colonel of the Garrison Shen Youzhi took up the post of Inspector of Southern Yan and marched north at the head of an army.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔曰：「法網之用，期世而行，寬惠之道，因時而布。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict said: "The use of the legal net is enacted age by age; the path of lenient favor is spread according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict said: "The legal net is tightened or loosened from age to age; lenient favor is dispensed as times require.

sentences.zh: 況朕尚德戡亂，依仁馭俗，宜每就弘簡，以隆至治。

translations.literal: Moreover I honor virtue in quelling disorder and guide the people by benevolence; at each turn one should incline toward breadth and simplicity to elevate perfect governance.
translations.idiomatic: I seek to quell disorder through virtue and govern the people with benevolence; at every turn policy should lean toward breadth and simplicity to perfect the realm's order.

sentences.zh: 而頻罹兵革，繇賦未休，軍民巧偽，興事甚多，蹈刑入憲，諒非一科。

translations.literal: Yet we have repeatedly suffered warfare; corvée and levies have not ceased; soldiers and civilians practice cunning fraud, and improper undertakings are many; those who tread the law and enter the statutes are surely not of one category alone.
translations.idiomatic: Yet war has come again and again, corvée and taxes remain unpaid, soldiers and civilians resort to fraud, and improper acts multiply; those who fall under the statutes are far more than one sort of offender.

sentences.zh: 至乃假名戎伍，竊爵私庭，因戰散亡，託懼逃役。

translations.literal: Some even borrow the name of the army, steal ranks in private houses, use battle dispersal and flight, and plead fear to escape service.
translations.idiomatic: Some borrow the army's name, steal office in private homes, scatter in defeat, and plead terror to evade service.

sentences.zh: 且往諸淪逼，雖經累宥，逋竄之黨，猶為實繁。

translations.literal: Moreover, though those who fled in past invasions have received repeated pardons, the bands still in hiding remain truly numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Though repeated amnesties have covered those who fled in past invasions, fugitives still abound.

sentences.zh: 宵言永懷，良兼矜疚。

translations.literal: Night thoughts keep me long mindful; I am indeed filled with compassionate remorse.
translations.idiomatic: Night after night I brood on this, heavy with compassionate remorse.

sentences.zh: 思所以重播至澤，覃被區宇。

translations.literal: I think how to spread supreme favor again and shower it over the realm.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to spread supreme favor once more and shower it across the realm.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: Let a general amnesty be proclaimed throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 」加新除左光祿大夫王玄謨車騎將軍。

translations.literal: Wang Xuamo, newly appointed Left Honored Grandee, was given the additional title General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xuamo, newly appointed Left Honored Grandee, was also made General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣吏部尚書褚淵慰勞緣淮將帥，隨宜量賜。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Director of the Ministry of Personnel Chu Yuan was sent to comfort and reward the generals along the Huai, with gifts measured to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Director of the Ministry of Personnel Chu Yuan was dispatched to comfort the Huai-front commanders and reward them as circumstances warranted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以新除右衞將軍劉勔為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen, newly appointed General of the Right Guard Liu Qin was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen newly appointed General of the Right Guard Liu Qin was made Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，鎮西將軍、雍州刺史巴陵王休若進號衞將軍，平西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: On guichou in the ninth month, Pacifying West General and Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuruo of Baling was promoted to Defender General; Leveling West General and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the ninth month Pacifying West General and Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuruo of Baling was promoted to Defender General, and Leveling West General and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以越騎校尉周寧民為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以皇后六宮以下雜衣千領，金釵千枚，班賜北征將士。

translations.literal: On wuwu, a thousand suits of miscellaneous garments from the empress and the six palaces below her, and a thousand gold hairpins, were distributed to the northern campaign troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the empress and the six palaces below her bestowed a thousand suits of clothing and a thousand gold hairpins upon the northern campaign forces.

sentences.zh: 庚申，前將軍兼冀州刺史崔道固進號平北將軍。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Forward General and concurrent Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Forward General and acting Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 甲子，曲赦徐、兗、青、冀四州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, a partial amnesty was granted to Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，改封新安王延年為始平王。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renwu, Prince Yannian of Xin'an was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renwu, Prince Yannian of Xin'an was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Rouran state sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復郡縣公田。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the public fields of commanderies and counties were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the public fields of commanderies and counties were restored.

sentences.zh: 鎮西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史吐谷渾拾寅進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: Pacifying West Grand General and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying West Grand General and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立建安王休仁第二子伯猷為江夏王，改封義陽王昶為晉熙王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Boyou, second son of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was established as Prince of Jiangxia; Prince Chang of Yiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Boyou, second son of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia, and Prince Chang of Yiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，分徐州置東徐州，以輔國將軍張讜為刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, Eastern Xuzhou was established by partitioning Xu; Assistant State General Zhang Dan was made its inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Eastern Xuzhou was carved out of Xu; Assistant State General Zhang Dan was appointed its inspector.

sentences.zh: 高麗國、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Koguryŏ and Paekche sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Koguryŏ and Paekche sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，以寧朔將軍劉休賓為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengchen in the twelfth month, Pacifying North General Liu Xiubin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the twelfth month Pacifying North General Liu Xiubin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己未，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jiwei, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Altar and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on jiwei in the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed at the Southern Altar in person and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚午，衞將軍巴陵王休若降號左將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Defender General Prince Xiuruo of Baling was demoted in title to Left General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Defender General Prince Xiuruo of Baling was reduced to Left General.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，零陵王司馬勗薨。

translations.literal: On yihai, Chief Clerk Sima Shen of Lingling died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Chief Clerk Sima Shen of Lingling died.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以前龍驤將軍常珍奇為平北將軍、司州刺史，珍奇子超越為北冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinchou in the second month, former Dragon-Charger General Chang Zhenqi was made Pacifying North General and Inspector of Si; Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the second month former Dragon-Charger General Chang Zhenqi was appointed Pacifying North General and Inspector of Si, and his son Chaoyue Inspector of Northern Ji.

sentences.zh: [15]乙巳，右光祿大夫、車騎將軍、護軍將軍王玄謨薨。

translations.literal: [15] On yisi, Right Honored Grandee, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo died.
translations.idiomatic: [15] On yisi Right Honored Grandee, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo died.

translations.literal: [16] On Right Honored Grandee, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo's death: the Sanzhao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read "Right Honored Grandee"; the Bureau edition and Wang Xuamo's biography read "Left Honored Grandee."
translations.idiomatic: [16] For Wang Xuamo's death the Sanzhao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read Right Honored Grandee; the Bureau edition and his biography read Left Honored Grandee.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，[17]以游擊將軍劉懷珍為東徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei in the third month, [17] Mobile Corps General Liu Huaizhen was made Inspector of Eastern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the third month, [17] Mobile Corps General Liu Huaizhen was appointed Inspector of Eastern Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以軍司馬劉靈遺為梁、南秦二州刺史，[18]南譙太守孫奉伯為交州刺史，[19]交州人李長仁據州叛。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Army Chief Administrator Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin; [18] Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao; [19] the man of Jiao Li Changren seized the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Army Chief Administrator Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin; [18] Southern Qiao Administrator Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao; [19] Li Changren of Jiao seized the province in revolt.

sentences.zh: 妖賊攻廣州，殺刺史羊希，[20]龍驤將軍陳伯紹討平之。

translations.literal: Demon rebels attacked Guang, killed Inspector Yang Xi, [20] and Dragon-Charger General Chen Bonian suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel bandits attacked Guang, killed Inspector Yang Xi, [20] and Dragon-Charger General Chen Bonian put them down.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，復減郡縣田祿之半。

translations.literal: On jimao in summer, the fourth month, the salary-fields of commanderies and counties were again reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the fourth month of summer the salary-fields of commanderies and counties were again cut by half.

sentences.zh: [21]丙申，東海王褘改封廬江王，[22]山陽王休祐改封晉平王，改晉安郡為晉平郡。

translations.literal: [21] On bingshen, Prince Yi of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang; [22] Prince You of Shanyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinping; Jin'an commandery was renamed Jinping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: [21] On bingshen Prince Yi of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang; [22] Prince You of Shanyang as Prince of Jinping; and Jin'an commandery was renamed Jinping.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，芮芮國及河南王並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Rouran state and the King of Henan both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Rouran and the King of Henan both sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以豫章太守張辯為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，[23]曲赦廣州。

translations.literal: On yisi in the fifth month, [23] a partial amnesty was granted to Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the fifth month, [23] Guang received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以行雍州刺史巴陵王休若行湘州刺史，會稽太守張永為雍州刺史，湘州刺史劉韞為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, Prince Xiuruo of Baling, acting Inspector of Yong, was made acting Inspector of Xiang; Administrator of Kuaiji Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Yong; Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Prince Xiuruo of Baling, acting Inspector of Yong, was also made acting Inspector of Xiang; Kuaiji Administrator Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Yong; and Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was transferred to Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，以南康相劉勃為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi in the eighth month, Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the eighth month Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was appointed Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: [24]辛卯，分青州置東青州，以輔國將軍沈文靖為東青州刺史。

translations.literal: [24] On xinmao, Eastern Qing was established by partitioning Qing; Assistant State General Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qing.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On xinmao Eastern Qing was carved out of Qing; Assistant State General Shen Wenjing was made its inspector.

sentences.zh: [25]丁酉，安南將軍、江州刺史王景文進號鎮南將軍。

translations.literal: [25] On dingyou, Pacifying South General and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: [25] On dingyou Pacifying South General and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，以驃騎長史張悅為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingchen in the ninth month, Chief Clerk of the Grand Marshal Who Pacifies the Cavalry Zhang Yue was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the ninth month Chief Clerk of the Grand Marshal Who Pacifies the Cavalry Zhang Yue was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔曰：「夫愆有小大，憲隨寬猛，故五刑殊用，三典異施。

translations.literal: On wuchen, an edict said: "Faults have large and small degrees; punishments follow leniency or severity; therefore the five punishments differ in use and the three codes differ in application.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen an edict said: "Offenses differ in gravity, and punishments in severity; hence the five punishments are not applied alike and the three codes are not enforced in one fashion.

sentences.zh: 而降辟次網，便暨鉗撻，求之法科，差品滋遠。

translations.literal: Yet when lesser penalties are reduced, one arrives at shackling and flogging; seeking the matter in the legal articles, the gradations grow ever farther apart.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when lesser penalties are eased, the path still leads to shackles and the rod; measured against the code, the gradations grow remote.

sentences.zh: 朕務存欽卹，每有矜貸。

translations.literal: I strive to preserve reverent compassion and am always inclined to pardon.
translations.idiomatic: I strive to govern with reverent compassion and am always ready to pardon.

sentences.zh: 尋劫制科罪，[26]輕重同之大辟，即事原情，未為詳衷。

translations.literal: Examining statutes on robbery, [26] light and heavy alike are classed with great execution; judging the matter by circumstance is not yet a detailed ruling.
translations.idiomatic: Under robbery statutes, [26] light and heavy cases alike are treated as capital offenses; judging each case on its merits is not yet a sufficient rule.

sentences.zh: 自今凡竊執官仗，拒戰邏司，或攻剽亭寺，及害吏民者，凡此諸條，悉依舊制。

translations.literal: From now on, all who steal official weapons, resist patrol officers in battle, or raid posts and temples and harm clerks and people—every such article—shall follow the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all who steal official arms, resist patrol officers, raid stations and temples, or harm officials and commoners shall be punished under the old statutes.

sentences.zh: 五人以下相逼奪者，可特賜黥刖，投畀四遠，仍用代殺，方古為優，全命長戶，施同造物。

translations.literal: Those who rob one another in bands of five or fewer may specially be granted tattooing and mutilation and sent to the four distant regions; the substitute execution is still used—compared with antiquity this is lenient, sparing life and preserving households, a kindness equal to creation itself.
translations.idiomatic: Bands of five or fewer who rob one another may instead receive tattooing and mutilation and exile to the four distant regions; substitute execution still applies—a mercy, by ancient standards, that spares life and preserves households, a kindness like that of Heaven itself.

sentences.zh: 庶簡惠之化，有孚羣萌，好生之德，無漏幽品。

translations.literal: May the transformation of simplicity and favor reach the masses with sincerity, and the virtue of cherishing life leave no dark corner untouched."
translations.idiomatic: May plain mercy reach the people in truth, and the virtue of cherishing life touch even the least among them."

sentences.zh: 」庚午，曲赦揚、南徐、兗、豫四州。

translations.literal: On gengwu, a partial amnesty was granted to Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guiyou, first day of new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guiyou, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 發諸州兵北討。

translations.literal: Troops from the various provinces were mobilized for the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Armies from the provinces were mobilized for the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 南康、建安、安成、宣城四郡，昔不同南逆，並不在徵發之例。

translations.literal: The four commanderies of Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng had never joined the southern rebellion and were all excluded from the levy.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng had never joined the southern rebellion and were exempted from the draft.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，割揚州之義興郡屬南徐州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Yixing commandery in Yangzhou was detached and placed under Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yixing commandery in Yangzhou was transferred to Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥，車駕躬耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on guihai, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on guihai in the first month of spring, the Emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，賜力田爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; those diligent in farming were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and diligent farmers were granted one noble rank.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，分豫州、揚州立南豫州，以太尉廬江王褘為車騎將軍，開府儀同三司、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingshen in the second month, Southern Yuzhou was established by partitioning Yu and Yang; Grand Minister of Works Prince Yi of Lujiang was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with an office equal to the Three Dukes and Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the second month Southern Yuzhou was carved out of Yu and Yang; Grand Minister of Works Prince Yi of Lujiang was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to a three-division office and Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，於南豫州立南義陽郡。

translations.literal: On yimao in the third month, Southern Yiyang commandery was established within Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the third month Southern Yiyang commandery was created within Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕幸中堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the imperial carriage visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Emperor visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits in person.

sentences.zh: 己巳，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jisi, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the King of Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，割雍州隨郡屬郢州。

translations.literal: On xinwei in summer, the fourth month, Suicheng in Yong was detached and placed under Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the fourth month of summer Suicheng in Yong was transferred to Ying.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，割豫州義陽郡屬郢州，郢州西陽郡屬豫州。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Yiyang commandery in Yu was detached and placed under Ying; Xiyang commandery in Ying was placed under Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yiyang in Yu was transferred to Ying, and Xiyang in Ying was transferred to Yu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以寧朔將軍崔公烈為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, General Who Pacifies the North Cui Gonglie was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi General Who Pacifies the North Cui Gonglie was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，新除給事黃門侍郎杜幼文為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuxu, newly appointed Bearer of the Gilded Gate Du Youwen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu newly appointed Bearer of the Gilded Gate Du Youwen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，立晉平王休祐子宣曜為南平王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinwei, Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinwei, Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: [27]壬申，以安西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗為鎮東將軍。

translations.literal: [27] On renshen, Pacifying West General and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: [27] On renshen Pacifying West General and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was promoted to General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以左衞將軍沈攸之為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On guiyou, General of the Left Guard Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou General of the Left Guard Shen Youzhi was appointed Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 以軍興已來，百官斷俸，並給生食。

translations.literal: Since military levies began, all officials' salaries were cut off, and raw grain was issued instead.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war mobilization began, officials' salaries were suspended and they were issued grain in kind instead.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，車騎將軍、南豫州刺史廬江王褘免官爵。

translations.literal: On dingchou, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Yi of Lujiang was stripped of office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Yi of Lujiang was deprived of office and noble rank.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左將軍、行湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Left General and acting Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Left General and acting Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was appointed General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，罷南豫州。

translations.literal: On renwu, Southern Yu was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Southern Yu was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以新除給事黃門侍郎劉亮為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingxu, newly appointed Bearer of the Gilded Gate Liu Liang was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu newly appointed Bearer of the Gilded Gate Liu Liang was appointed Inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，以輔國將軍王亮為徐州刺史，東莞太守陳伯紹為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiyou, Assistant State General Wang Liang was made Inspector of Xu; Administrator of Dongguan Chen Bonian was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, Assistant State General Wang Liang was made Inspector of Xu and Administrator of Dongguan Chen Bonian Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以山陽太守李靈謙為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Administrator of Shanyang Li Lingqian was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Administrator of Shanyang Li Lingqian was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改輔國將軍為輔師將軍。

translations.literal: On renxu, Assistant State General was renamed Assistant Master General.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the title Assistant State General was changed to Assistant Master General.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，以右將軍行豫州刺史劉勔為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jichou, Right General and acting Inspector of Yu Liu Kan was made General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou, Right General and acting Inspector of Yu Liu Kan was appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以海陵太守劉崇智為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, Administrator of Hailing Liu Chongzhi was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Administrator of Hailing Liu Chongzhi was appointed Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，立長沙王纂子延之為始平王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin, Yanzhi, son of Prince Zuan of Changsha, was established as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin, Yanzhi, son of Prince Zuan of Changsha, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊午，中領軍王琨遷職。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Colonel of the Garrison Wang Kun was transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Colonel of the Garrison Wang Kun was reassigned.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔曰：「夫箕、潁之操，振古所貴，沖素之風，哲王攸重。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict said: "The conduct of [Xu You of] Ji and [Xu Chao of] Ying has been prized through the ages, and the style of pure simplicity has been esteemed by sage kings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict said: "The integrity of the recluses of Ji and Ying has been honored since antiquity, and the spirit of plain simplicity has been prized by wise rulers.

sentences.zh: 朕屬橫流之會，接難晦之辰，龕暴剪亂，日不暇給。

translations.literal: I have met a time of rushing torrents and taken the throne in troubled, dark days, suppressing violence and cutting down disorder, with not a day to spare.
translations.idiomatic: I came to the throne amid flood and turmoil, in days of hardship and obscurity, suppressing cruelty and quelling rebellion, with scarcely a moment to rest.

sentences.zh: 今雖關、隴猶靄，區縣澄氛，偃武修文，於是乎在。

translations.literal: Now though the passes and Long regions are still clouded, districts and counties are clearing; to lay aside arms and cultivate culture is what we aim at now.
translations.idiomatic: Now though the frontier passes and Long region remain troubled, the districts are growing calm; the time has come to sheathe arms and foster learning.

sentences.zh: 思崇廉耻，用靜馳薄，固已物色載懷，寢興竚歎。

translations.literal: Thinking to exalt integrity and shame, and by that to still reckless pursuit, I have long searched in my thoughts and slept and risen in sighing expectation.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to exalt integrity and shame and thereby still the rush of shallow ambition; I have long kept such men in mind, waking and sleeping in eager hope.

sentences.zh: 其有貞栖隱約，息事衡樊，[28]鑿坏遺榮，負釣辭聘，志恬江海，行高塵俗者，在所精加搜括，時以名聞。

translations.literal: Those who dwell in steadfast retirement, rest in their homesteads, [28] break their wall and leave glory behind, carry rods and decline office, whose will is tranquil as rivers and seas and whose conduct rises above vulgar dust—such persons are to be carefully sought out and promptly made known by name.
translations.idiomatic: Those who live in steadfast seclusion, keep to their lanes and gardens, [28] break their wall and renounce rank, fish by the stream and refuse summons, whose hearts are calm as the rivers and seas and whose conduct towers above the vulgar—such men are to be diligently sought and promptly reported by name.

sentences.zh: 將賁園矜德，茂昭厥禮。

translations.literal: We shall enrich gardens and honor virtue, and abundantly display their rites.
translations.idiomatic: We shall enrich their estates and honor their virtue, and make their rites resplendent.

sentences.zh: 羣司各舉所知，以時授爵。

translations.literal: Each office should recommend those it knows, granting ranks as the seasons require.
translations.idiomatic: Every office should recommend those it knows, granting noble ranks in due season.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，以新除平西將軍、豫州刺史劉勔為中領軍。

translations.literal: " On yichou, newly appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu Liu Kan was made Colonel of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: " On yichou newly appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu Liu Kan was appointed Colonel of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingmao, first day of new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingmao, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, the Northern Wei sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, the Northern Wei sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子，驃騎大將軍、荊州刺史晉平王休祐以本號為南徐州刺史，征南將軍、湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征西將軍、荊州刺史，輔師將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史，[29]義陽太守呂安國為司州刺史。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wuzi, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was made Southern Xu inspector under his former title; General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Jing; Assistant Master General Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yan; [29] Administrator of Yiyang Lü Anguo was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuzi, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was transferred to Southern Xu under his former title; General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Jing; Assistant Master General Meng Ciyang was appointed Inspector of Yan; [29] and Administrator of Yiyang Lü Anguo Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，司徒建安王休仁解揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Minister of Works Prince Xiuren of Jian'an relinquished the post of Inspector of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Minister of Works Prince Xiuren of Jian'an resigned as Inspector of Yang.

sentences.zh: 己未，以征北大將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範為中書監、中軍將軍、揚州刺史，[30]吳興太守建平王景素為湘州刺史，輔師將軍建安王世子伯融為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Grand General Who Campaigns North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand Master of the Palace Archives, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang; [30] Administrator of Wuxing Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Xiang; Assistant Master General Heir of Jian'an Prince Bozhong was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Grand General Who Campaigns North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed Grand Master of the Palace Archives, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang; [30] Administrator of Wuxing Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Xiang; and Assistant Master General Heir of Jian'an Prince Bozhong Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: [31]庚申，分荊、益州五郡置三巴校尉。

translations.literal: [31] On gengshen, five commanderies of Jing and Yi were split off to establish the Colonel of the Three Ba.
translations.idiomatic: [31] On gengshen five commanderies of Jing and Yi were detached to establish the Colonel of the Three Ba.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月乙亥，初制間二年一祭南郊，間一年一祭明堂。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on yihai, it was first decreed that the Southern Altar be sacrificed to every two years in alternation and the Hall of Illumination every year in alternation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on yihai in the first month of spring, it was first ordained that the Southern Altar be sacrificed to in alternate years and the Hall of Illumination in the years between.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，司徒建安王休仁為太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renyin, Minister of Works Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Grand Commandant, retaining the post of Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renyin, Minister of Works Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was appointed Grand Commandant while retaining the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，皇太子納妃。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Heir Apparent took a consort.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Heir Apparent received a consort.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 巧注從軍，不在赦例。

translations.literal: Those who forged registers to enter the army were excluded from the amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had falsified records to join the army were excluded from the amnesty.

sentences.zh: 班賜各有差。

translations.literal: Graded gifts were distributed.
translations.idiomatic: Graded gifts were distributed to all.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，中護軍劉襲卒。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yihai, Colonel of the Palace Guard Liu Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai, Colonel of the Palace Guard Liu Xi passed away.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太子詹事張永為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，立第六皇子燮為晉熙王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guihai, the sixth prince, Xie, was established as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai, the sixth prince Xie was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，以前軍將軍陳胤宗為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingchou, former Forward General Chen Yinzong was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingchou, former Forward General Chen Yinzong was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以冠軍將軍吐谷渾拾虔為平西將軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Champion General Tuyuhun Shiqian was made General Who Levels the West.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Champion General Tuyuhun Shiqian was promoted to General Who Levels the West.

sentences.zh: 戊子，奉朝請孔玉為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Court Gentleman-at-Attendance Kong Yu was made Inspector of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Court Gentleman-at-Attendance Kong Yu was appointed Inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，以第五皇子智井繼東平沖王休倩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jihai, the fifth prince Zhijing succeeded Eastern-Pacification Prince Chong of Dongping, Xiuxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai, the fifth prince Zhijing succeeded Chong Prince of Eastern Pacification Xiuxian of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以侍中劉韞為撫軍將軍、雍州刺史，前將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號鎮軍將軍，揚州刺史桂陽王休範為征南大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Palace Attendant Liu Yun was made General Who Comforts the Army and Inspector of Yong; Forward General and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Guards the Army; Inspector of Yang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Palace Attendant Liu Yun was appointed General Who Comforts the Army and Inspector of Yong; Forward General and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Guards the Army; and Inspector of Yang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史王景文為尚書左僕射、揚州刺史，尚書僕射袁粲為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On guimao, General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing on the Left and Inspector of Yang; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Vice Director on the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang, and Vice Director Yuan Can Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 己未，改臨賀郡為臨慶郡，追改東平王休倩為臨慶沖王。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Linhe commandery was renamed Linqing commandery, and Prince Xiuxian of Dongping was posthumously renamed Chong Prince of Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Linhe commandery was renamed Linqing, and Prince Xiuxian of Dongping was posthumously styled Chong Prince of Linqing.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，第五皇子智井薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on bingxu, the fifth prince Zhijing died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingxu, the fifth prince Zhijing passed away.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，中領軍劉勔加平北將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yichou, Colonel of the Garrison Liu Kan was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yichou, Colonel of the Garrison Liu Kan was also made General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立總明觀，徵學士以充之。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Zongming Hall was established; scholars were summoned to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Zongming Hall was founded and scholars were summoned to staff it.

sentences.zh: 置東觀祭酒。

translations.literal: A Sacrificer of the Eastern Pavilion was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: A Sacrificer of the Eastern Pavilion was installed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以第八皇子智渙繼臨慶沖王休倩。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the eighth prince Zhihuan succeeded Chong Prince of Linqing, Xiuxian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the eighth prince Zhihuan succeeded Chong Prince of Linqing Xiuxian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，立第九皇子贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinmao, the ninth prince, Zan, was established as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao, the ninth prince Zan was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以前右軍馬詵為北雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi, former General of the Right Army Ma Shen was made Inspector of Northern Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi former General of the Right Army Ma Shen was appointed Inspector of Northern Yong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕幸東堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Emperor visited the Eastern Hall to hear lawsuits in person.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi, the state of Koguryŏ sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, Koguryŏ sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，以邊難未息，制父母陷異域，悉使婚宦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guisi, because border troubles had not ceased, it was decreed that all whose parents were trapped in foreign lands should marry and take office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, because the frontier war had not ended, the court decreed that all whose parents were held in enemy territory must marry and accept office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以始興郡為宋安郡。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Shixing commandery was made Song'an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Shixing commandery was renamed Song'an.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，護軍將軍張永遷職。

translations.literal: On bingchen, General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was reassigned.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinyou, the Northern Wei sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, the Northern Wei sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，芮芮國遣使奉獻。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Rouran state sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，減天下死罪一等，凡敕繫悉遣之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinchou, capital crimes throughout the realm were reduced one degree; all held under imperial order were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, death sentences throughout the realm were commuted one degree and all prisoners held under imperial writ were released.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，於南兗州置新平郡。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xinping commandery was established within Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xinping commandery was created within Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金紫光祿大夫張永領護軍。

translations.literal: On guichou, Grand Master of the Golden Gate and the Purple Dawn Zhang Yong concurrently held the post of General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Grand Master of the Golden Gate and the Purple Dawn Zhang Yong was also made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，司徒建安王休仁有罪，自殺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuwu, Minister of Works Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was guilty of crime and committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu, Minister of Works Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was found guilty and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以寧朔長史孫超之為廣州刺史，尚書左僕射、揚州刺史王景文以刺史領中書監。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Chief Clerk of Pacifying the North Sun Chaozhi was made Inspector of Guang; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing on the Left and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen held the post of Inspector while also serving as Grand Master of the Palace Archives.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Chief Clerk of Pacifying the North Sun Chaozhi was appointed Inspector of Guang; Left Vice Director and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen retained the inspectorate while also serving as Grand Master of the Palace Archives.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以尚書右僕射袁粲為尚書令，新除吏部尚書褚淵為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing on the Right Yuan Can was made Director; newly appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Vice Director on the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Right Vice Director Yuan Can was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing, and newly appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel Chu Yuan Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: [32]辛未，監吳郡王僧虔行湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [32] On xinwei, Acting Inspector of Wu commandery Wang Sengqian was made acting Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: [32] On xinwei Acting Inspector of Wu Wang Sengqian was appointed acting Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，追免晉平王休祐為庶人。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was posthumously stripped and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was posthumously disgraced and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以征南大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範為驃騎大將軍、南徐州刺史，征北大將軍巴陵王休若為車騎大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu; Grand General Who Campaigns North Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Grand General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu, and Grand General Who Campaigns North Prince Xiuruo of Baling General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Rouran state sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，罷散騎奏舉郎。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingsi, the policy recommenders of the Scattered Cavalry were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingsi, the Scattered Cavalry recommendation officers were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，新除車騎大將軍、江州刺史巴陵王休若薨，桂陽王休範以新除驃騎大將軍，還為江州。

translations.literal: On yichou, newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling died; Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, newly appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry, returned to Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling died; Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, newly made Grand General of Agile Cavalry, returned to Jiang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以第三皇子準為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the third prince, Zhun, was made General Who Comforts the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the third prince Zhun was appointed General Who Comforts the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事劉秉為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was made Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was appointed Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以寧朔將軍沈懷明為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General Who Pacifies the North Shen Huaiming was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin General Who Pacifies the North Shen Huaiming was appointed Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，於冀州置西海郡。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Xihai commandery was established within Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Xihai commandery was created within Ji.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，第八皇子躋繼江夏文獻王義恭。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi, the eighth prince Ji succeeded Literary and Illustrious Prince Yigong of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi, the eighth prince Ji was made heir to Literary and Illustrious Prince Yigong of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以疾愈大赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengyin, because the Emperor's illness had improved, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, because the Emperor had recovered, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冀州刺史劉崇智加青州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Ji Liu Chongzhi was given the additional post of Inspector of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Ji Liu Chongzhi was also made Inspector of Qing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立第三皇子準為安成王。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the third prince Zhun was established as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the third prince Zhun was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以越騎校尉周寧民為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinwei, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午，[33]百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on wuwu, [33] the state of Paekche sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuwu, [33] Paekche sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，分豫州、南兗州立南豫州，以歷陽太守王玄載為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, Southern Yu was established by partitioning Yu and Southern Yan; Administrator of Liyang Wang Xuanzai was made Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, Southern Yu was carved out of Yu and Southern Yan; Administrator of Liyang Wang Xuanzai was appointed its inspector.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年春正月甲寅朔，上有疾不朝會。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiyu, spring, first month, on jiayin, first day of new moon, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiyu, on jiayin, the first day of the first month of spring, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 以疾患未痊，故改元。

translations.literal: Because his illness had not yet healed, the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Because his illness had not yet healed, the reign era was changed.

sentences.zh: 賜孤老貧疾粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: The orphaned, aged, poor, and sick were granted grain and cloth in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The orphaned, aged, poor, and sick received grain and cloth in graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，皇太子會萬國於東宮，并受貢計。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Heir Apparent received the tribute of the myriad states in the Eastern Palace and accepted the tribute tallies as well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Heir Apparent received the tribute of the myriad states at the Eastern Palace and took charge of the tribute accounts.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以給事黃門侍郎王瞻為司州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinchou, Bearer of the Gilded Gate Wang Zhan was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, Bearer of the Gilded Gate Wang Zhan was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guichou, first day of new moon, the state of Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou, the first day of the month, Linyi sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，中書監、揚州刺史王景文卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Grand Master of the Palace Archives and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Grand Master of the Palace Archives and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以撫軍司馬蔡那為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao, Army Major of the Comforting Army Cai Na was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinmao, Army Major of the Comforting Army Cai Na was appointed Inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以右衞將軍張興世為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi, General of the Right Guard Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi General of the Right Guard Zhang Xingshi was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: [34]己亥，上大漸。

translations.literal: [34] On jihai, the Emperor's illness grew critical.
translations.idiomatic: [34] On jihai the Emperor's illness turned critical.

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範進位司空，尚書右僕射褚淵為護軍將軍，中領軍劉勔加尚書右僕射，鎮東將軍蔡興宗為征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史，鎮軍將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was advanced to Minister of Works; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing on the Right Chu Yuan was made General Who Protects the Army; Colonel of the Garrison Liu Kan was given the additional post of Vice Director on the Right; General Who Pacifies the East Cai Xingzong was made General Who Campaigns West, Establishing-Ceremony Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Jing; General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to Pacifying West General.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was promoted to Minister of Works; Right Vice Director Chu Yuan was made General Who Protects the Army; Colonel of the Garrison Liu Kan was also made Right Vice Director; General Who Pacifies the East Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Campaigns West, Establishing-Ceremony Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Jing; and General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi Pacifying West General.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕自臨御億兆，仍屬戎寇，雖每存弘化，而惠弗覃遠，軍國凋弊，刑訟未息。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since I took the throne over the multitude, we have still met with armed enemies; though I have always held to broad transformation, favor has not spread far, the army and state are exhausted, and lawsuits have not ceased.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Since I ascended the throne to rule the myriad people, we have still faced armed enemies; though I have always sought broad reform, grace has not reached far, the army and state are exhausted, and lawsuits have not ceased.

sentences.zh: 今大漸維危，載深矜歎。

translations.literal: Now my illness grows grave and dangerous, and I am filled with deep compassionate sighing.
translations.idiomatic: Now my illness grows grave, and I am filled with deep compassionate sorrow.

sentences.zh: 可緩徭優調，去繁就約。

translations.literal: Let corvée be eased and levies be lightened; cast off complexity and pursue simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: Ease corvée and lighten levies; cast off complexity and pursue simplicity.

sentences.zh: 因改之宜，詳有簡衷。

translations.literal: According to what reform requires, give detailed and measured selection.
translations.idiomatic: According to what reform requires, choose measures with careful judgment.

sentences.zh: 務以愛民為先，以宣朕遺意。

translations.literal: Take cherishing the people as the foremost duty, to proclaim my final intent.
translations.idiomatic: Make cherishing the people the foremost duty, and proclaim my final intent.

sentences.zh: 」袁粲、褚淵、劉勔、蔡興宗、沈攸之同被顧命。

translations.literal: " Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Qin, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were together entrusted with the regency.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Qin, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were all named to the regency council.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩于景福殿，時年三十四。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor died in Jingfu Hall, aged thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the Emperor died in Jingfu Hall, at the age of thirty-four.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，葬臨沂縣莫府山高寧陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin, he was buried at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mofu Hill in Linyi county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the fifth month he was buried at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mofu Hill in Linyi county.

sentences.zh: 帝少而和令，風姿端雅。

translations.literal: The Emperor from youth was gentle and agreeable, with a dignified and refined bearing.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he was gentle and gracious, his bearing dignified and refined.

sentences.zh: 早失所生，養於太后宮內。

translations.literal: He lost his birth mother early and was raised within the Empress Dowager's palace.
translations.idiomatic: He lost his birth mother young and was raised in the empress dowager's palace.

sentences.zh: 大明世，諸弟多被猜忌，唯上見親，常侍路太后醫藥。

translations.literal: In the Daming era his younger brothers were often suspected, but he alone was treated with affection and regularly attended Empress Dowager Lu in her medicine and care.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daming reign his brothers were often suspected, yet he alone remained close to the throne, regularly attending Empress Dowager Lu at her sickbed.

sentences.zh: 好讀書，愛文義，在藩時，撰江左以來文章志，又續衞瓘所注論語二卷，行於世。

translations.literal: He loved reading and cherished literary principle; while in his princedom he compiled a register of writings from the Eastern Jin onward, and also continued Wei Guan's commentary on the Analects in two juan, which circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He loved books and literary craft; as a prince he compiled a bibliography of writings since the Eastern Jin, continued Wei Guan's two-juan commentary on the Analects, and saw both works circulate.

sentences.zh: 及即大位，四方反叛，以寬仁待物，諸軍帥有父兄子弟同逆者，並授以禁兵，委任不易，故眾為之用，莫不盡力。

translations.literal: When he ascended the great throne, the four quarters rebelled; he treated men with broad kindness. For army commanders whose fathers, brothers, or sons had joined the rebellion together, he still entrusted them with palace guards, and his commissions did not shift easily; therefore the masses served him and none failed to exert their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Once on the throne he faced rebellion on every side, yet treated men with generous forbearance. Commanders whose kin had risen against him still received palace-guard appointments; his trust did not waver, and they fought for him with all their strength.

sentences.zh: 平定天下，逆黨多被全，其有才能者，並見授用，有如舊臣。

translations.literal: When the realm was pacified, rebels were for the most part spared; those with ability were all employed, as if they were old ministers.
translations.idiomatic: After the realm was pacified most rebels were spared; the capable were taken into service as though they had always been his ministers.

sentences.zh: 才學之士，多蒙引進，參侍文籍，應對左右。

translations.literal: Men of talent and learning were often brought forward, attending on his literary records and answering at his side.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and men of letters were often advanced to wait on his papers and answer at his side.

sentences.zh: 於華林園含芳堂講周易，[35]常自臨聽。

translations.literal: At Hanfang Hall in Hualin Park he lectured on the Changes; [35] he often listened in person.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured on the Changes at Hanfang Hall in Hualin Park; [35] he often attended in person.

sentences.zh: 末年好鬼神，多忌諱，言語文書，有禍敗凶喪及疑似之言應回避者，數百千品，有犯必加罪戮。

translations.literal: In his later years he favored spirits and ghosts and had many taboos; in speech and documents, words of disaster, defeat, mourning, and suspicious phrases to be avoided numbered in the hundreds and thousands of categories, and violation was always punished with death.
translations.idiomatic: In his last years he grew obsessed with omens and taboos: hundreds of categories of ill-omened words—disaster, defeat, mourning, and the like—were banned from speech and documents, and any breach brought execution.

sentences.zh: 改「騧」為馬邊瓜，[36]亦以「騧」字似「禍」字故也。

translations.literal: He changed the character gua to "horse-beside-melon," [36] because the character gua also resembles the character for "calamity."
translations.idiomatic: He split the character gua into ma bian gua ("horse beside melon"), [36] because gua resembles the character for calamity.

sentences.zh: 以南苑借張永，云「且給三百年，期訖更啟」。

translations.literal: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, "Grant it for three hundred years; when the term ends, report again."
translations.idiomatic: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong with the words, "Let it be three hundred years; when the term ends, petition again."

sentences.zh: 其事類皆如此。

translations.literal: Matters of this sort were all like this.
translations.idiomatic: His conduct was full of such instances.

sentences.zh: 宣陽門，民間謂之白門，上以白門之名不祥，甚諱之。

translations.literal: The Xuanyang Gate the common people called the White Gate; the Emperor regarded the name White Gate as inauspicious and greatly tabooed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanyang Gate was popularly called the White Gate; the Emperor found the name inauspicious and fiercely forbade it.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞江謐嘗誤犯，上變色曰：「白汝家門！

translations.literal: Right Assistant in the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once blundered into the taboo; the Emperor changed color and said, "White your family gate!
translations.idiomatic: Right Assistant in the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once tripped over the taboo; the Emperor flushed and said, "May your own gate be white!

sentences.zh: 」謐稽顙謝，久之方釋。

translations.literal: " Mi knocked his head in apology and was long in coming to release.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Mi kowtowed in terror and was not forgiven for a long while.

sentences.zh: 太后停屍漆牀先出東宮，上嘗幸宮，見之怒甚，免中庶子官，職局以之坐者數十人。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager's corpse rested on a lacquered couch it was first moved out of the Eastern Palace; the Emperor once visited the palace, saw it, and was furious beyond measure; he dismissed the Palace Attendant, and several tens in the bureaus were punished for it.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager's body was laid on a lacquered couch and moved out of the Eastern Palace ahead of the rites, the Emperor visited the palace, flew into a rage, dismissed the Palace Attendant, and punished dozens of staff in the bureaus.

sentences.zh: [37]內外常慮犯觸，人不自保。

translations.literal: [37] Within and without, all constantly feared giving offense; no one could feel secure.
translations.idiomatic: [37] Court and capital lived in fear of giving offense; no one felt safe.

sentences.zh: 宮內禁忌尤甚，移牀治壁，必先祭土神，使文士為文詞祝策，如大祭饗。

translations.literal: Taboos within the palace were especially severe: to move a bed or repair a wall, one first had to sacrifice to the Earth God and have literati compose prayer-texts and blessing-documents, as at a great offering.
translations.idiomatic: Palace taboos were harshest of all: moving a bed or repairing a wall required sacrifice to the Earth God and literati-drafted prayers, as for a major state offering.

sentences.zh: 泰始、泰豫之際，更忍虐好殺，左右失旨忤意，往往有斮刳斷截者。

translations.literal: Between the Taishi and Taiyu eras he became more cruel and fond of killing; those at his side who missed his intent and offended his mood were often hacked, gouged, or cut apart.
translations.idiomatic: From the Taishi into the Taiyu years he turned crueler and bloodier; attendants who missed his mood were often hacked apart or dismembered.

sentences.zh: 時經略淮、泗，軍旅不息，荒弊積久，府藏空竭。

translations.literal: At the time the court was campaigning on the Huai and Si, armies never rested, ruin had piled up for long years, and the treasury was empty.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigns on the Huai and Si never ceased; years of devastation had emptied the treasury.

sentences.zh: 內外百官，並日料祿俸；

translations.literal: Civil and military officials alike were rationed their salaries by the day;
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials alike received salaries by the day;

sentences.zh: [38]而上奢費過度，務為彫侈。

translations.literal: [38] yet the Emperor was extravagant beyond measure and pursued carved luxury.
translations.idiomatic: [38] while the Emperor spent without limit and demanded ever more ornament.

sentences.zh: 每所造制，必為正御三十副，御次、副又各三十，須一物輒造九十枚，天下騷然，民不堪命。

translations.literal: For every object he ordered made, there had to be thirty sets for the chief imperial use, and thirty each for the secondary and tertiary grades; a single item required ninety copies, and the realm was in uproar—the people could not bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: Every new object had to be made in thirty sets for the chief imperial use and thirty each for secondary and tertiary grades—ninety copies of a single thing—and the realm groaned under a burden it could not bear.

sentences.zh: 其餘事迹，列見眾篇。

translations.literal: His remaining deeds are set out in the other chapters.
translations.idiomatic: His other deeds are recorded in the chapters that follow.

sentences.zh: [39]親近讒慝，剪落皇枝，宋氏之業，自此衰矣。

translations.literal: [39] Favoring slanderers close at hand, he pruned the imperial branches, and the house of Song from this point declined.
translations.idiomatic: [39] He heeded jealous counselors at his side, cut down the imperial clansmen, and the Liu-Song house began its decline from that hour.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：聖人立法垂制，所以必稱先王，蓋由遺訓餘風，足以貽之來世也。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: The sage establishes law and leaves institutions behind; therefore he must invoke the former kings, for it is through surviving instruction and lingering custom that one can bequeath guidance to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer writes: The sage sets law and leaves institutions behind, and therefore always invokes the former kings—surviving instruction and lingering custom are what a dynasty bequeaths to those who come after.

sentences.zh: 太祖負扆南面，實有君人之懿焉，經國之義雖弘，而隆家之道不足。

translations.literal: The Founder, bearing the imperial screen and facing south, truly had the bearing of a lord of men; his principles for ordering the state were broad, yet his way of exalting the family was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen, facing south with the imperial screen at his back, truly had a ruler's bearing; his vision for governing the realm was broad, but his care for the imperial house was not enough.

sentences.zh: 彭城王照不窺古，本無卓爾之資，[40]徒見昆弟之義，未識君臣之禮，冀以此家情，行之國道，主猜而猶犯，恩薄而未悟，致以呵訓之微行，遂成滅親之大禍。

translations.literal: Prince Zhao of Pengcheng did not look to antiquity and by nature lacked outstanding endowment; [40] he saw only the righteousness between brothers and did not understand the rites between ruler and minister, hoping to carry this family sentiment into the way of the state. The lord was suspicious yet he still offended; favor was thin yet he did not awaken—leading from a slight act of reprimand to the great calamity of destroying kin.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhao of Pengcheng did not study antiquity and lacked talent that stood apart; [40] he knew only brotherly duty, not the rites between sovereign and minister, and tried to govern a realm with the logic of a household. His lord grew suspicious yet he pressed on; favor thinned yet he never understood—until a word of rebuke opened the way to the catastrophe of kin slaughter.

sentences.zh: 開端樹隙，垂之後人。

translations.literal: He opened the breach and planted the rift, and bequeathed it to those who came after.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the crack and planted the feud, and left both to posterity.

sentences.zh: 雖天倫之重，義殊凡戚，而中人以下，情由恩變。

translations.literal: Though the weight of heaven's kin differs in principle from ordinary kinship, for men of middling virtue and below, feeling follows favor.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's kinship weighs differently from ordinary ties, yet for any man of middling feeling and below, affection answers to grace received.

sentences.zh: 至於易衣而出，分苦而食，與夫別宮異門，形疎事隔者，宜有降矣。

translations.literal: As for exchanging clothes to go out, sharing hardship in eating, compared with dwelling in separate palaces and separate gates, form distant and affairs divided—there ought to be a descent.
translations.idiomatic: To exchange clothes and go abroad together, to share bitter fare—set that against separate palaces and separate gates, kinship thinned to form and affairs cut off—and the distance ought to be plain.

sentences.zh: 太宗因易隙之情，據已行之典，剪落洪枝，願不待慮。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong, exploiting the ease of rifts in feeling, relied on precedent already in practice, pruned the great branches, and did not wait for forethought.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming seized on those family fractures, invoked precedents already in use, and lopped the great branches of the clan without pausing to reckon the cost.

sentences.zh: 既而本根無庇，幼主孤立，神器以勢弱傾移，靈命隨樂推回改。

translations.literal: Thereafter the root had no shelter, the young lord stood alone, the regalia shifted because power was weak, and the mandate changed as joyous acclaim turned elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the trunk stood unprotected, a child emperor stood alone, the throne shifted as power thinned, and the mandate changed hands with the next wave of acclamation.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋履霜有漸，堅冰自至，所從來遠也。

translations.literal: This is surely like frost underfoot growing step by step until solid ice arrives of itself—the source lies far back.
translations.idiomatic: This is the old lesson of frost underfoot and solid ice gathering by degrees—the ruin was long in coming.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: 南徐州刺史永嘉王子仁為中軍將軍 各本並脫「南」字，據永嘉王子仁傳補。

translations.literal: Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Central Army: in all editions the character "south" is omitted; supplemented according to the biography of Prince Ziren of Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ziren of Yongjia as Inspector of Southern Xu made General of the Central Army: all editions drop nan (south); restored from his biography.

sentences.zh: 癸酉 各本並作「壬午」，據建康實錄改。

translations.literal: On guiyou: in all editions this reads "renwu"; emended according to the Jiankang Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Guiyou day: all editions read renwu; corrected per Jiankang Shilu.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚申朔，十三日壬申，十六日乙亥。

translations.literal: According to this month's gengshen new moon, the thirteenth day is renshen and the sixteenth day is yihai.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on gengshen; the thirteenth day was renshen and the sixteenth yihai.

sentences.zh: 宋書本紀此詔在十三日壬申後，十六日乙亥前，則作壬午誤，作癸酉是。

translations.literal: This edict in the Song Shu annals falls after the thirteenth day, renshen, and before the sixteenth day, yihai; thus renwu is wrong and guiyou is correct.
translations.idiomatic: In this annals the edict falls after renshen on the thirteenth and before yihai on the sixteenth, so renwu is wrong and guiyou correct.

sentences.zh: 詳悉條奏 「詳」各本並作「許」，據元龜二一三改。

translations.literal: "Report in full by article": in all editions "xiang" appears as "xu"; emended according to Yuan Gui 213.
translations.idiomatic: "Report in full by article": all editions read xu for xiang; corrected per Yuan Gui, juan 213.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍劉勔前鋒西討 「西討」各本作「南討」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Assistant State General Liu Qin as vanguard campaigning west: in all editions "west campaign" appears as "south campaign"; emended according to the Nan Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qin as vanguard on the western campaign: all editions read "southern campaign"; corrected per Nan Shi.

sentences.zh: 按劉勔時攻壽陽，當云「西討」。

translations.literal: According to this, at the time Liu Qin was attacking Shouyang and it should read "west campaign."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qin was then attacking Shouyang; "western campaign" is correct.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍殷孝祖攻赭圻死之以輔國將軍沈攸之代為南討前鋒 「撫軍」下脫文十三字，據南史補。

translations.literal: General Who Comforts the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zhuyi and died; Assistant State General Shen Youzhi replaced him as vanguard of the southern campaign: below "General Who Comforts the Army" thirteen characters are missing; supplemented according to the Nan Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Xiaozu, General Who Comforts the Army, died attacking Zhuyi; Shen Youzhi replaced him as southern vanguard: all editions omit thirteen characters after "General Who Comforts the Army"; restored from Nan Shi.

sentences.zh: 時殷孝祖為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: At the time Yin Xiaozu was General Who Comforts the Army.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yin Xiaozu held the post of General Who Comforts the Army.

sentences.zh: 史事參沈攸之傳、殷孝祖傳。

translations.literal: The events are compared in the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu.
translations.idiomatic: See the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu.

sentences.zh: 葬崇憲皇太后於修寧陵 「修」各本並譌「攸」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Burial of Empress Dowager Chongxian at Xiuning Mausoleum: in all editions "xiu" is corrupted to "you"; emended according to the Nan Shi and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Burial of Empress Dowager Chongxian at Xiuning Mausoleum: all editions corrupt xiu as you; corrected per Nan Shi and Zizhi Tongjian.

sentences.zh: 通鑑胡三省注曰：「修寧陵，在孝武陵東南。」

translations.literal: The Comprehensive Mirror, Hu Sanxing's note, says: "Xiuning Mausoleum lies southeast of Xiaoling."
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sanxing notes in the Zizhi Tongjian: "Xiuning Mausoleum lies southeast of Xiaoling."

sentences.zh: 以建安王休仁世子伯融為豫州刺史 「豫州」建安王休仁傳作「南豫州」。

translations.literal: Heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an Boroong was made Inspector of Yu: in the biography of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an it reads "Southern Yu."
translations.idiomatic: Boroong, heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, as Inspector of Yu: his father's biography reads Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 以吳郡太守顧覬之為湘州刺史 「覬」各本並作「顗」，據覬之傳改。

translations.literal: Administrator of Wu commandery Gu Kuizhi was made Inspector of Xiang: in all editions "kui" appears as "yi"; emended according to the biography of Kuizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Kuizhi, Administrator of Wu, as Inspector of Xiang: all editions read yi for kui; corrected per Kuizhi's biography.

sentences.zh: 曲赦揚南徐二州 各本並脫「南」字，據建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Partial amnesty for Yang and Southern Xu: in all editions the character "south" is omitted; supplemented according to the Jiankang Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Partial amnesty for Yang and Southern Xu: all editions omit nan (south); restored per Jiankang Shilu.

sentences.zh: 出獻納貢 「出」元龜一九八作「來」。

translations.literal: Presenting tribute at the audience for submission: in Yuan Gui 198 "present" appears as "come."
translations.idiomatic: Tribute presented at the audience: Yuan Gui, juan 198, reads "come" for "present."

sentences.zh: 夫秉機詢政 「秉」各本並作「矢」，據元龜二一二改。

translations.literal: "Holding the reins and inquiring into government": in all editions "hold" appears as "arrow"; emended according to Yuan Gui 212.
translations.idiomatic: "Holding the reins of power": all editions read "arrow" for "hold"; corrected per Yuan Gui, juan 212.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍劉靈遺為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉靈遺」各本並作「劉靈道」。

translations.literal: Assistant State General Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: in all editions "Liu Lingyi" appears as "Liu Lingdao."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lingyi as Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: all editions read Liu Lingdao; should be Liu Lingyi.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作『劉靈遺』，鄧琬傳可證。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes says: "It should read 'Liu Lingyi'; the biography of Deng Wan can verify it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes: "Should read Liu Lingyi, as the biography of Deng Wan proves.

sentences.zh: 下四年亦作『劉靈遺』。

translations.literal: In the fourth year below it also reads 'Liu Lingyi.'"
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year below also has Liu Lingyi."

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Zhang's argument, it is so; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang is correct; the text is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 以游擊將軍垣閎為益州刺史 「垣閎」各本並作「垣閬」。

translations.literal: Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yi: in all editions "Yuan Hong" appears as "Yuan Lang."
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hong as Inspector of Yi: all editions read Yuan Lang for Yuan Hong.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「垣閬，大明三年已為竟陵王誕所殺，見垣護之傳。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes says: "Yuan Lang, in the third year of Daming, had already been killed by Prince Dan of Jingling, as seen in the biography of Yuan Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai notes: "Yuan Lang was killed in Daming year 3 by Prince Dan of Jingling (see the biography of Yuan Hu).

sentences.zh: 此為垣閎之誤。

translations.literal: This is an error for Yuan Hong."
translations.idiomatic: This should be Yuan Hong."

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Zhang's argument, it is so; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang is right; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞羊希為廣州刺史 「羊希」各本並作「羊南」，據羊玄保傳，兄子希時由御史中丞出為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yang Xi was made Inspector of Guang: in all editions "Yang Xi" appears as "Yang Nan"; according to the biography of Yang Xuanbao, his nephew Xi at this time left the post of Censor-in-Chief to become Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xi as Inspector of Guang: all editions read Yang Nan; Yang Xuanbao's biography shows his nephew Xi leaving the censorate for Guang at this time.

sentences.zh: 「南」字誤，今改正。

translations.literal: The character "nan" is wrong; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Nan is wrong; emended.

sentences.zh: 珍奇子超越為北冀州刺史 孫虨宋書考論云：「劉勔傳，超越為北豫州刺史，非北冀州。」

translations.literal: Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji: Sun Fen's Song Shu Studies says, "In the biography of Liu Qin, Chaoyue is Inspector of Northern Yu, not Northern Ji."
translations.idiomatic: Chaoyue, son of Zhenqi, as Inspector of Northern Ji: Sun Fen notes Liu Qin's biography makes him Inspector of Northern Yu, not Northern Ji.

sentences.zh: 右光祿大夫車騎將軍護軍將軍王玄謨薨 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「右光祿大夫」，局本及王玄謨傳作「左光祿大夫」。

translations.literal: Right Honored Grandee, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo died: the Sanzhao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read "Right Honored Grandee"; the Bureau edition and Wang Xuamo's biography read "Left Honored Grandee."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xuamo's death: Sanzhao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read Right Honored Grandee; the Bureau edition and his biography read Left Honored Grandee.

sentences.zh: 三月己未 下有戊辰。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiwei, below there is wuchen.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiwei day: below this entry stands wuchen.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙子朔，無己未、戊辰。

translations.literal: According to this month's bingzi new moon, there are no jiwei or wuchen.
translations.idiomatic: That month opened on bingzi; neither jiwei nor wuchen occurs.

sentences.zh: 二十日乙未，二十三日戊戌。

translations.literal: The twentieth day is yiwei and the twenty-third day is wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: The twentieth day is yiwei and the twenty-third wuxu.

sentences.zh: 己未或乙未之譌，戊辰或戊戌之譌。

translations.literal: Jiwei may be a corruption of yiwei; wuchen may be a corruption of wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei is probably yiwei miscopied; wuchen probably wuxu miscopied.
