sentences.zh: 以軍司馬劉靈遺為梁南秦二州刺史 孫虨宋書考論云：「軍上脫一字。」

translations.literal: Army Chief Administrator Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: Sun Fen's Song Shu Studies says, "One character is missing above 'army.'"
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lingyi as Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: Sun Fen notes one character missing before "army."

sentences.zh: 南譙太守孫奉伯為交州刺史 「南譙」各本並作「譙南」，據州郡志訂正。

translations.literal: Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao: in all editions "Southern Qiao" appears as "Qiao South"; corrected according to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Fengbo of Southern Qiao as Inspector of Jiao: all editions reverse the commandery name; corrected per the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 殺刺史羊希 「羊希」各本並譌「羊南」，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑及本書羊玄保傳兄子希附傳改正。

translations.literal: Killed Inspector Yang Xi: in all editions "Yang Xi" is corrupted to "Yang Nan"; corrected according to the Nan Shi, Jiankang Shilu, Comprehensive Mirror, and the attached biography of Xi in the biography of Yang Xuanbao in this book.
translations.idiomatic: Killed Inspector Yang Xi: all editions corrupt Xi as Nan; corrected per Nan Shi, Jiankang Shilu, Zizhi Tongjian, and Xi's entry under Yang Xuanbao in this book.

sentences.zh: 復減郡縣田祿之半 「田祿」各本及通鑑並作「田租」。

translations.literal: Again reduced the salary-fields of commanderies and counties by half: in all editions and the Comprehensive Mirror this reads "field-tax."
translations.idiomatic: Salary-fields of commanderies and counties again halved: all editions and the Tongjian read "land tax."

sentences.zh: 按普減國內田租之半，決非專制帝王之所肯為，當是減削郡縣官吏田祿之半。

translations.literal: According to this, a universal halving of land-tax throughout the realm is certainly not what a despotic emperor would permit; it should be reducing the salary-fields of commandery and county officials by half.
translations.idiomatic: A general halving of land tax empire-wide is not what even a tyrant would decree; the passage must mean halving officials' salary-fields.

sentences.zh: 建康實錄作「田祿」，是。

translations.literal: The Jiankang Shilu reads "salary-fields"; it is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang Shilu has salary-fields (tian lu); that reading is correct.

sentences.zh: 今據改。

translations.literal: Now emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 丙申東海王褘改封廬江王 各本並脫去「丙申」二字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: On bingshen Prince Yi of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang: in all editions the two characters "bingshen" are omitted; supplemented according to the Nan Shi and Jiankang Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi of Donghai re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang on bingshen: all editions omit the date; restored per Nan Shi and Jiankang Shilu.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳 各本並作「乙未」，按是月乙巳朔，無乙未。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yisi: in all editions this reads "yiwei"; according to this month's yisi new moon, there is no yiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi day: all editions read yiwei; that month opened on yisi, so yiwei cannot occur.

sentences.zh: 下有十九日癸亥。

translations.literal: Below there is the nineteenth day, guihai.
translations.idiomatic: The nineteenth day below is guihai.

sentences.zh: 此乙未當是乙巳之誤，今改正。

translations.literal: This yiwei should be the error for yisi; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwei is a miscopy of yisi; corrected.

sentences.zh: 以南康相劉勃為交州刺史 張森楷校勘記云：「劉勔傳，有弟斅，泰始中，為寧朔將軍、交州刺史，於道遇病卒。

translations.literal: Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiao: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes says, "In the biography of Liu Qin there is a younger brother Jiao, who in the Taishi era was General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Jiao and died of illness on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bo of Nankang as Inspector of Jiao: Zhang Senkai notes Liu Qin's biography has a younger brother Jiao, made Inspector of Jiao in the Taishi era and dead of illness en route.

sentences.zh: 勃、斅形近，當即一人。」

translations.literal: Bo and Jiao are graphically near; they must be one man."
translations.idiomatic: Bo and Jiao are near in form; they must be the same man."

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍沈文靖為東青州刺史 「沈文靖」沈文秀傳及通鑑作「沈文靜」。

translations.literal: Assistant State General Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qing: in the biography of Shen Wenxiu and the Comprehensive Mirror this reads "Shen Wenjing."
translations.idiomatic: Shen Wenjing as Inspector of Eastern Qing: Shen Wenxiu's biography and the Tongjian read Shen Wenjing (jing 靜 for jing 靖).

sentences.zh: 尋劫制科罪 「劫」各本並作「剏」。

translations.literal: Soon seizing control and imposing statutory punishment: in all editions "seize" appears as "create."
translations.idiomatic: Soon seizing power and imposing statutory penalties: all editions read "create" for "seize."

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「當云劫制，剏字誤。

translations.literal: Sun Fen's Song Shu Studies says: "It should read seizing control; the character create is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Fen: "Should read seizing control (jiezhi); create (chuang) is wrong.

sentences.zh: 」按孫說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Sun's argument, it is so; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Sun is correct; emended.

sentences.zh: 立晉平王休祐子宣曜為南平王 各本並脫「立」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was established as Prince of Nanping: in all editions the character "establish" is omitted; supplemented according to the Nan Shi and Jiankang Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping: all editions omit "establish"; restored per Nan Shi and Jiankang Shilu.

sentences.zh: 息事衡樊 「息」各本並作「自」，據元龜二一三及六四五改正。

translations.literal: Resting affairs and balancing the scales: in all editions "rest" appears as "from"; corrected according to Yuan Gui 213 and 645.
translations.idiomatic: "Resting affairs and balancing the scales": all editions read "from" for "rest"; corrected per Yuan Gui, juan 213 and 645.

sentences.zh: 輔師將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史 各本並脫「次」字，據阮佃夫傳、殷琰傳補。

translations.literal: Assistant State General Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yan: in all editions the character "ci" is omitted; supplemented according to the biographies of Ruan Dianfu and Yin Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Ciyang as Inspector of Yan: all editions omit ci from his name; restored per Ruan Dianfu's and Yin Yan's biographies.

sentences.zh: 以征北大將軍南徐州刺史桂陽王休範為中書監中軍將軍揚州刺史 「中軍將軍」各本並作「中將軍」，據桂陽王休範傳補。

translations.literal: Grand General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiubian of Guiyang was made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang: in all editions "General of the Central Army" appears as "Central General"; supplemented according to the biography of Prince Xiubian of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiubian of Guiyang, Grand General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu, made Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang: all editions read Central General for General of the Central Army; restored per his biography.

sentences.zh: 輔師將軍建安王世子伯融為廣州刺史 各本並脫「伯」字。

translations.literal: Assistant State General Boroong, heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was made Inspector of Guang: in all editions the character "bo" is omitted.
translations.idiomatic: Boroong, heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, as Inspector of Guang: all editions omit bo from his name.

sentences.zh: 據始安王休仁傳補。

translations.literal: Supplemented according to the biography of Prince Xiuren of Shian.
translations.idiomatic: Restored from the biography of Prince Xiuren of Shian.

sentences.zh: 新除吏部尚書褚淵為尚書右僕射 「右僕射」各本及通鑑並作「左僕射」。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing: in all editions and the Comprehensive Mirror this reads "Left Vice Director"; now emended according to the biography of Chu Yuan in the Qi Shu, Nan Shi, and Jiankang Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Yuan, newly appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel, as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing: all editions and the Tongjian read Left Vice Director; corrected per Chu Yuan's biography in Southern Qi Shu, Nan Shi, and Jiankang Shilu.

sentences.zh: 今據南齊書褚淵傳、南史、建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Now emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午 「十一月」各本並作「十月」。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on wuwu: in all editions "eleventh month" appears as "tenth month."
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu day: all editions read tenth month for eleventh.

sentences.zh: 據建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Emended according to the Jiankang Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected per Jiankang Shilu.

sentences.zh: 按十月丙戌朔，無戊午。

translations.literal: According to this, in the tenth month on bingxu new moon there is no wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month opened on bingxu; wuwu does not occur there.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯朔，初四日戊午。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on yimao new moon, the fourth day is wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month opened on yimao; the fourth day is wuwu.

sentences.zh: 以右衞將軍張興世為雍州刺史 各本並脫「世」字。

translations.literal: Right Guard General Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yong: in all editions the character "shi" is omitted.
translations.idiomatic: On Zhang Xingshi as Inspector of Yong: all editions omit shi from his name.

sentences.zh: 據張興世傳補。

translations.literal: Supplemented according to the biography of Zhang Xingshi.
translations.idiomatic: Restored from Zhang Xingshi's biography.

sentences.zh: 於華林園含芳堂講周易 各本並脫「含」字，據元龜一九二補。

translations.literal: At Hualin Park's Hanfang Hall he lectured on the Changes: in all editions the character "han" is omitted; supplemented according to Yuan Gui 192.
translations.idiomatic: Lectured on the Changes at Hanfang Hall in Hualin Park: all editions omit han; restored from Yuan Gui, juan 192.

sentences.zh: 改騧為馬邊瓜 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本無「馬」字，今據局本及魏書島夷傳、南史補。

translations.literal: Changed gua to mabian gua: the Sanzhao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions lack the character "ma"; corrected according to the Bureau edition, the Wei Shu Barbarians of the Isles, and the Nan Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Substitution of gua with mabian gua: Sanzhao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions lack ma; restored from the Bureau edition, Wei Shu (Barbarians of the Isles), and Nan Shi.

sentences.zh: 職局以之坐者數十人 魏書島夷傳、南史、建康實錄「坐」下有「死」字。

translations.literal: Those in the bureaus punished for it numbered several tens: the Wei Shu Barbarians of the Isles, Nan Shi, and Jiankang Shilu have the character "death" below "punished."
translations.idiomatic: Dozens in the bureaus were punished for the offense: Wei Shu, Nan Shi, and Jiankang Shilu add si (put to death) after zuo.

sentences.zh: 並日料祿俸 各本並同。

translations.literal: Daily ration of salaries: all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: "Daily ration of salaries": all editions read the same.

sentences.zh: 魏書島夷傳作「普斷祿奉」。

translations.literal: The Wei Shu Barbarians of the Isles reads "universally cut off salaries."
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shu has "salaries cut off wholesale."

sentences.zh: 南史及通鑑作「並斷祿奉」。

translations.literal: The Nan Shi and Comprehensive Mirror read "universally cut off salaries" with "bing."
translations.idiomatic: Nan Shi and Zizhi Tongjian read "salaries cut off in common."

sentences.zh: 列見眾篇 三朝本作「列」。

translations.literal: "Listed in many chapters": the Sanzhao edition reads "lie."
translations.idiomatic: "Listed in the other chapters": the Sanzhao edition reads lie (列).

sentences.zh: 北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「別」。

translations.literal: The Beijian, Mao, Dian, and Bureau editions read "bie" (separate).
translations.idiomatic: Beijian, Mao, Dian, and Bureau editions read bie (別, separately).

sentences.zh: 張元濟校勘記云：「所見處不止一篇，故云列見眾篇。」

translations.literal: Zhang Yuanji's Collation Notes says: "The places seen are not limited to one chapter, hence the phrase 'listed in many chapters.'"
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuanji's Collation Notes explains: "The references appear in more than one chapter, hence liejian zhong pian."

sentences.zh: 本無卓爾之資 「資」各本作「姿」，據南史改。

translations.literal: "He lacked outstanding endowment": all editions read "zi" (bearing) for "zi" (endowment); emended according to the Nan Shi.
translations.idiomatic: "Lacked talent that stood apart": all editions read zi (bearing) for zi (endowment); corrected to Nan Shi's zi (資).
